core_obligations: The author proves epsilon-orthogonality for iteratively decomposed k-class particle chains through quantitative partition-function and typical-configuration estimates, then transfers the gap to nearest-neighbor biased transpositions. Logarithmic minimum class size, bounded weak monotonicity and all parameter definitions remain exactly as stated; related long-range-chain and mixing consequences form one object.
